subject.title: feat: inspect background tasks across web and mobile

question: Should tasks.get expose bounded task prompt text to every operator.read client, or should prompt retrieval require a narrower scope or stronger redaction contract?
rationale: The PR intentionally expands a sanitized task-summary API to include user-authored task input, which may contain private operational context or secrets; automated correctness checks cannot decide the intended authorization boundary.

options.title: Approve operator.read with safeguards
options.body: Keep the current scope, explicitly document that task prompts are readable operator data, and add focused tests proving list/events omit prompts and tasks.get strips internal context.

options.title: Require a stronger scope
options.body: Gate prompt retrieval behind operator.admin or a new explicit capability while leaving ordinary task status and output available to operator.read.

options.title: Omit prompts for now
options.body: Land cross-client status and output inspection without prompt disclosure, then add prompts in a separately reviewed security-boundary change.

recommendation.title: Approve operator.read with safeguards
recommendation.body: Keep the current scope, explicitly document that task prompts are readable operator data, and add focused tests proving list/events omit prompts and tasks.get strips internal context.

likelyOwner.reason: The available ownership guidance connects him to both agent behavior and security boundaries.
